variants.after: That whispered promise you traded for the terrified deacon's silence hangs heavy in the flickering candlelight, a fresh debt newly minted in the shadows that grants you this temporary, uneasy sanctuary.

Below, the heavy tramp of watchmen's boots echoes from the cobblestones, confirming that the spared deacon ran straight to the authorities; his loose tongue guarantees you have only moments before they sweep the upper storeys.

The sickening thud of the deacon striking the paving stones still echoes in your mind, a ruthless sacrifice that stains the night but ensures no living witness can direct the constables toward your skyward escape.

You pull the dead Archbishop's heavy cloak tighter across your shoulders, acutely aware that its fine weave and ecclesiastical cut mark you as a walking corpse if any patrol spots you lingering near the window.

Shrugging the disgraced tailor's debt coat to settle its awkward weight, you note how the mismatched panels blend perfectly into the city's grime, a humble disguise that has miraculously shielded you from passing lanterns.
Coarse wool chafes your neck as you shift in the rough porter's livery, smelling faintly of river mud and sweat, a degrading but necessary facade to mask the dangerous agility of a true night-crow.
